title: The normalized underlying map of the native action Hom comparison
statement: Fix an ordinary NativeFrobeniusRingedModel A and a specified twisted action presentation P [lem-sf-native-frobenius-ringed-model, def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data]. The functor A.toWeil P carries the action-site internal Hom naturally to native internal Hom [lem-sf-native-action-site-hom-comparison], with underlying component exactly A.E.functor.map(P.hom(M,N).hom) followed by A.hom(U(M),U(N)).hom. The sites and equivalences are specified inputs; neither their existence nor any derived assertion is concluded.

source.place: Internal-Hom/evaluation paragraph; the normalized component construction of lem-sf-native-action-site-hom-comparison, step 2.

proof.text: Use the already proved action_hom_component for each pair; its underlying map is E(P.hom) followed by A.hom by construction. P.hom_naturality followed by A.hom_naturality proves naturality after applying native forgetting. Faithfulness of native forgetting proves the native naturality equation. NatIso.ofComponents assembles the isomorphism, and its normalization is reflexivity.

theorem normalized_action_hom
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (A : NativeFrobeniusRingedModel k₀ l X)
    (P : TwistedActionRingedSite.Presentation A.J A.s A.R A.a) :
    letI := P.category
    ∃ h : Functor.uncurry.obj (SheafOfModules.homFunctor (R := P.coefficient)) ⋙
        A.toWeil P ≅ ((A.toWeil P).op.prod (A.toWeil P)) ⋙
          Functor.uncurry.obj (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X),
      ∀ M N : TwistedActionRingedSite.Modules P.coefficient,
        (h.hom.app (op M, N)).hom.f = A.E.functor.map (P.hom M N).hom ≫
          (A.hom (P.modules.functor.obj M).obj.a (P.modules.functor.obj N).obj.a).hom
